units.function: Mocked filesystem/module/fetch unit suite for generated catalog manifest caching/reload, published package layout resolution, binary preview rejection, commit-pinned GitHub file reads and optional-catalog failure handling.
units.dependencyDirection: Tests import the catalog service with mocked Node filesystem, module resolution, logger and global fetch. They exercise service parsing/resolution logic without package-manager authenticity, real filesystem/symlink behavior or network transport.
units.keyDataModels: Catalog manifest schema/package metadata; CatalogSkill trust/compatibility/role/source; per-file size/hash and aggregate contentHash; local bundled path; GitHub owner/repo/ref/full commit/path; unavailable-manifest error/cache.
units.lifecycle: Resolve package/manifest; synchronously load and cache; reload after stat change; resolve Skill; reject asset preview; read bundled or commit-pinned remote file; return an empty catalog and log once when optional package resolution fails.
units.testAssessment: All 235 lines were read once and focused Vitest passed all 5 tests. The suite usefully locks package-layout compatibility, manifest refresh, binary handling, commit-pinned remote URLs and log-storm prevention. It does not test schema rejection, duplicate/ambiguous IDs, path traversal/symlinks, file or aggregate quotas, redirect/private-network policy, timeouts, response/content type, post-read hash/size mismatch, signatures/publisher/license, cache race/same-stat replacement or recovery from negative cache.
units.designRationale: Treat the bundled catalog as an optional generated package that can be consumed from source or published layouts, cached cheaply and queried uniformly across local and pinned GitHub-backed entries.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs a capability-package registry whose availability, publisher/license/signature, immutable manifest, byte integrity, trust classification and admission health are explicit and independently deployable in cloud or offline enterprise profiles.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the commit-pinned remote resolution, binary-safe distinction, package-layout compatibility tests and bounded warning behavior. Add signed/SPDX manifests, authenticated publisher identity, post-fetch digest/size verification, network/path/redirect quotas, structured health state, refresh/recovery and immutable admission receipts before use.
units.responsibilityConflict: The manifest/test model carries technical trust and compatibility but no publisher/license/legal responsibility, approved package policy or accountable-human admission evidence. Fail-soft empty results can hide a governance subsystem outage from ordinary callers.
evidence: 5e086cb828dac27a3fd16bf22e71597382458c85 fix(server): resolve published skills catalog package root and fallback (#8327)
focused Vitest: 1 file passed, 5 tests passed
securityFindings: No tests require publisher identity, signature, SPDX/license or authenticated manifest provenance.
Remote content is commit-pinned but the suite does not prove fetched bytes are checked against manifest size/hash.
No traversal, symlink, duplicate path/ID, file-count/byte/decompression bomb or schema-resource-limit cases are covered.
No redirect, private-network, timeout, response-size or content-type policy is tested for remote reads.
Permanent negative caching plus empty-list fallback can mask a catalog integrity/availability failure and block recovery.
Cache reload coverage does not test same mtime/size replacement, concurrent readers or partially written manifests.
